title: Solar System Surface Technosignatures: Searching for Signs of Artificial Design on Extraterrestrial Terrain
abstract: arXiv:2610.28687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial radio emissions have historically been a major focus of technosignature searches. Here, we apply an anthropological lens to expand this scope to surface technosignatures: non-random, intentional patterning on planetary terrain, similar to long-lasting human-made landscapes and monuments on Earth. On geologically inactive bodies such as the Moon and Mars, artificial traces and patterns could potentially remain visible for hundreds of millions of years. We discuss two recent developments that make this search timely: high-resolution imaging datasets, such as those produced by the HiRISE camera on the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), and ML-based anomaly-detection methods. Finally, we list two possible approaches to developing a model capable of searching for these surface technosignatures: a supervised and an unsupervised one. translated_title: 太阳系表面技术签名：在地外地形上搜寻人工设计的迹象
translated_abstract: 人工射电信号历来是技术签名搜寻的主要焦点。在此，我们运用人类学视角将搜寻范围扩展至表面技术签名：即行星地形上非随机的、有意为之的图案，类似于地球上持久存在的人造景观和纪念物。在月球和火星等地质不活跃的天体上，人工痕迹和图案可能保持可见达数亿年之久。我们讨论了使这一搜寻恰逢其时的两项最新进展：高分辨率成像数据集（例如火星勘测轨道飞行器（MRO）上HiRISE相机产生的数据），以及基于机器学习的异常检测方法。最后，我们列出了开发能够搜寻这些表面技术签名模型的两种可能方法：监督学习和无监督学习。结合激光雷达、探地雷达和反射光谱学，这些方法将……
tldr: 该论文提出将技术签名搜索从人工射电信号扩展到行星表面的非随机人工图案，并建议结合高分辨率影像数据与机器学习异常检测方法，在月球和火星等地质不活跃天体上寻找可能存留数亿年的人工设计痕迹。
en_tdlr: This paper expands technosignature searches beyond artificial radio emissions to surface technosignatures—intentional, non-random patterns on planetary terrain—proposing machine learning-based anomaly detection applied to high-resolution imaging data to search for artificial designs that could persist for hundreds of millions of years on geologically inactive bodies like the Moon and Mars.
